summary:
macOS / Interix only (dbus#584). The out-of-bounds stack write is in the
select()-based emulation of poll() in _dbus_poll(), which is compiled only
when HAVE_POLL is unset or BROKEN_POLL is defined; dbus-sysdeps.h defines
BROKEN_POLL only for __APPLE__ and __INTERIX. On Linux the build has
HAVE_POLL and _dbus_poll() calls poll() directly (and dbus-daemon uses the
epoll main loop), so the vulnerable code is not built. Debian marks it
unimportant: "Doesn't affect Linux (unless intentionally compiling dbus
with -DBROKEN_POLL)".

https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-128885
